dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You stand behind the counter. After a short while, a customer walks in...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What are you doing in Nod-Krai, Chevreuse? A—Are you here to catch someone?

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Not quite. I'm here to scout out a location for the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol to conduct special training.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: The Patrol has always trained in Fontaine — it's become far too routine.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Now, when we train, everyone's moving their arms and legs, but they're not engaging their brains! They're just mechanically fulfilling their daily training quota.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: If things go on like this, the Patrol is going to lose the ability to react to sudden events and changing circumstances.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: That's why I plan to regularly take us beyond Fontaine's borders to train in unfamiliar surroundings.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Lady Nefer's already helped me find a location, I'm just dropping by to pay for her services.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: #Since you're the one on duty today, {NICKNAME}, I'll entrust this money to you. Please make sure it gets back to her.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Alright, I'll take my leave. I need to return to Fontaine and get everything ready.

choices.text: But aren't you worried I might...

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: I trust in your moral character.
